input.body:
Job Id: NBL-008-3466
Address: Flat 5, 55 Lantern Quay, Cedarford, ZZ2 4ZZ

Hello Alder Compliance,

Thank you for your estimate of £1,370.00 for the check-out works. Before we send it to the landlord for approval, please reply with:
1. An itemised price for each part of the job: (a) bathroom sand, fill and damp paint; (b) main room walls and ceiling; (c) bathroom lino replacement; (d) plug; (e) shelf; (f) bath tap.
2. Which plug you mean. Our check-out report records a broken basin plug, but your estimate says "plug socket". If you mean an electrical socket, please tell us what is wrong with it. Any electrical work must be done by an NICEIC/NAPIT-registered electrician.
3. Whether the dripping bath tap can be repaired (e.g. new washer or cartridge) rather than replaced, and the price for each option.
4. What is causing the water egress from the shower area onto the boxing and lino (e.g. failed sealant or tray). Damp paint and new lino will not last if the cause is not fixed. Please include a price to fix the cause if needed.
5. Whether the price includes VAT.

Noted that you recommend keeping the main-room carpet.

Please do not start any work yet. The landlord has not approved it, and we will confirm in writing once they do.

Regards,
Northbridge Lettings
